notes.title: Major Gameplay Update
notes.content:
Community,
this update implements more of your feedback!

We are adding new difficulty modes to the single player campaign. The previous standard difficulty reamins as 'Easy'. Plus, the overall multiplayer difficulty has been increased drastically.

New visual effects, HUD improvements and higher rewards for each completed multiplayer and single player match add exciting new experience facets to Cyborg Rage.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11808009/34e78517045e37c3447bb97e9da80272d2e781f2.gif[/img]

Like always, if you have any feedback for us, leave a comment or you can use the contact form in the main menu of the game!


[h1]Update 1.16.08.23[/h1]


[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
- The Single Player Campaign now offers four difficulties:
   - EASY: For beginners with little or no experience in space scrolling shooters
   - MEDIUM: For intermediats with some experience
   - HARD: For Cyborg Rage veterans
   - BRUTAL: For Cyborg Rage experts

- Completing the Single Player Campaign now grants immediate access to a new league if the chosen difficulty reflects a higher league than the current player league
- Completing the Single Player Campaign now grants a high credit reward (depending on the chosen difficulty)
- The Single Player has now an ending screen that summarizes and concludes the story.
- Added screen shaking effects for explosions with more BOOM! and BAM! So to speak.
- The HUD shows weapon icons so players can identify the correct weapon charge status more easily
- The HUD shows the key bindings for each ship weapon for players in Bronze and Silver league

[b]GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
- Based on your feedback, the overall difficulty has been increased
- The required rank to achieve a new league has been reduced (value depends on league)
- Friendly AI has improved detection for situations in which Nano Repair Impulse is needed by player or by itself
- The required amount of enemy ship destruction for earning stars has been increased
- The prices for gallery unlocks have been decreased
- The medal requirements have been decreased
- The default key bindings were improved to W,A,S,D for basic controls and Space,Q,E,F for the weapons. You can re-adjust the key bindings in the options menu.

[b]LOBBY[/b]
- The current rank and league is now shown in the Single Player Lobby, not only in Multiplayer


Hope you enjoy this update!

Cheers,

Dominik
Ragiva Games

http://store.steampowered.com/app/429160

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
Community,
this major update comes directly from us to you!

With this update, we are implementing Keyboard and Gamepad controls (any USB gamepads are supported) as so many of you requested. We suggest you take a look at the settings menu where you can adjust the key/button setup to your preference.

We received plenty of feedback in form of mails via the ingame feedback form and via Steam. Thank you for both, your positive encouraging feedback and your constructive critics and improvement suggestions! Although we read all of it, we cannot implement the changes quite as fast as we wish we could - but we're constantly on it. Today we deliver some of the changes.

Check the new controls out and see if everything goes fine for you. If not, let us know! Keep sending us your feedback through the in-game form if you would like to contact us directly, we're happy to read your feedback and ideas! What other features or changes would you like to see happening in the future development?


[code]Major Update Version 1.16.04.20

New Features
• Keyboard and Gamepad controls implemented
• Last Login name is now saved and restored on restart

Bugs fixed
• Fixed a bug where the lighting engine could make the light effects way too bright and fill the screen
• Fixed a bug where some sound effects would not play in Multiplayer
• Fixed a bug where the Graphic settings would not be saved[/code]


We hope you enjoy this update!

Cheers,

Dominik
Ragiva Games
